name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a pre-fabricated shower unit?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a custom tile shower and a pre-fabricated shower unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom tile shower offers superior design flexibility, allowing for personalized sizes, shapes, tile patterns, and features that perfectly match your aesthetic and functional needs. Pre-fabricated shower units, conversely, are standard-sized, mass-produced enclosures that offer less customization and can sometimes have a more uniform appearance. The practical tradeoff is that while custom tile showers require a longer installation timeline and higher upfront cost, they provide enhanced durability, unique design, and often better long-term value and satisfaction compared to pre-fabricated options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom tile showers offer personalized design and features, while pre-fabricated units are standard-sized and less customizable.
